login.heading: Sign in
login.subheading: Use the work email you were given.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.comingSoon: this feature is not built yet.

validation.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.

register.heading: Create a workspace
register.subheading: It takes about a minute. You will be the owner.
register.pitch: Set up a workspace for your company.

gets.isolatedA: Your own workspace — your company data

register.codeTip: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. Cannot be changed later.
register.codeTipA: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
register.emailTip: This will be your sign-in email.
register.passwordTip: Use a sentence you can remember. Longer is safer — no special characters needed.
register.passwordTipA: Use a sentence you can remember.
register.passwordTipB: Longer is safer — no special characters needed.
register.comingSoon: this feature is not built yet.

done.heading: Your workspace is ready
done.text: You are the owner. Next step: invite your colleagues.

validation.codeInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; start with a letter.
validation.codeLength: The code must be 3 to 30 characters long.
validation.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.
validation.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters.
validation.termsRequired: You need to accept the terms to continue.

users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, or paste an email
users.copyFailed: Your browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.
users.roleTip: The role decides what this person can do. You can change it later.
users.roleEffect: A role change takes effect on their next request; they do not need to sign in again.
users.permissionNote: Permissions come from the ROLE, never from an individual grant. If you need a different set, create a new role.

validation.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.

handover.title: How will they get their account?
handover.text: There is no mail service yet, so no invitation can be sent. You will get a temporary password to hand over yourself.
handover.force: Require a password change on first sign-in

done.title: Account created for {{name}}
done.warning: This is the only time you will see this password. Closing this dialog loses it — you would have to reset it. Give it to {{name}} now.

empty.title: Nobody here but you
empty.text: Add colleagues so they can sign in. You choose the role for each of them.

noMatch.title: No one matches
noMatch.text: Try removing a filter, or check the search term.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.text: A disabled person can no longer sign in, but their data and past messages stay. This is what to do when someone leaves — not deletion.
danger.locked: You cannot disable yourself or the owner. Transfer ownership first if you need to.

link.title: Account link
link.text: Profile {{code}} is linked to this account. Unlinking keeps both — they just split back into two rows. Use it when the wrong people got linked.
link.onlyUnlinked: Only rows that are not linked to anything yet.
link.hint: Once linked, the two rows become one. You can unlink again any time from the detail drawer.
link.done: Profile and account are now linked.
link.noCandidate: There is no unlinked profile or account left to pick.
link.emailPrefilled: Prefilled from the email on the profile. Change it if this person signs in with a different address.
link.newAccountNote: You will see a temporary password once, and the new account is linked to this profile straight away.
link.newProfileNote: The new profile is linked to this account straight away. Department and phone can be filled in later from the directory.
link.codeNote: The code is on the contract and the badge, so it cannot be changed after creation.

reset.title: Password
reset.why: There is no email service yet, so "Forgot password" does not work — this is the only way back in for someone locked out. Resetting signs them out everywhere.
reset.what: A temporary password is generated and shown once, for you to hand over. {{name}} will have to change it at their next sign-in.
reset.kicks: Every device they are signed in on is signed out immediately, phones included. That is deliberate: the most common reason to reset is a suspected account takeover.
reset.onceOnly: This is the only time you will see this password. Closing the dialog loses it — you would have to reset again.

bulk.disableWarning: These people will not be able to sign in any more, but their data and past messages stay. You can re-enable them at any time.

willSkip.vaitro: {{count}} skipped: no login account, or the workspace owner.
willSkip.vohieu: {{count}} skipped: no account, already disabled, yourself, or the workspace owner.

bulk.noneEligible: None of the selected people can take this action.

users.noAccountYet: This person has no login account yet, so there is nothing to edit here.

transfer.title: Workspace ownership
transfer.text: Hand the workspace to {{name}}. You drop to Admin and cannot take it back yourself — only the owner can transfer it.
transfer.noUndo: This cannot be undone. After the transfer, only {{name}} can hand it back to you.
transfer.effect1: {{name}} becomes Owner and gets all 12 permissions.
transfer.effect2: You drop to Admin — every permission except the one you just handed over.
transfer.effect3: From then on, only {{name}} can disable you, change your role, or reset your password.
transfer.passwordWhy: Type it again so we know this is you, not someone who sat down at your machine.

account.mustChange: This account is on a temporary password. Please change it now.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Every other device has been signed out.

personal.title: Personal details
personal.text: Colleagues see your name in the directory and when you send messages.

field.emailLocked: Changing the sign-in email goes through an administrator — it identifies the account.
field.roleLocked: Nobody can change their own role.

password.title: Change password
password.text: Use a sentence you can remember. Longer is safer — no special characters needed. At least 10 characters.
password.warning: Changing your password signs out every other device — including your phone.

appearance.title: Theme & language
appearance.text: This choice is yours alone — it is stored on your machine and changes nothing for colleagues. It follows your system light/dark setting by default.

display.title: Display
display.collapseText: Icons only, leaving more room for content.

validation.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters.
validation.mismatch: The two entries do not match.

roles.locked: The four system roles are read-only. They are rebuilt in every workspace from one definition in the source, so an edit here would be overwritten by the next upgrade without warning. Company-defined roles are the next step — not built yet.

describe.Owner: Workspace owner. Holds every permission, including transferring ownership.
describe.Admin: Administers the whole workspace: people, departments, roles.
describe.Manager: Runs their own department. Currently IDENTICAL to Member — the leave.approve permission does not exist yet, so nothing separates the two.
describe.Member: Regular employee. Currently can only view the employee directory.

perm.workspaceTransferWhy: Hands the workspace to someone else. The giver loses Owner immediately.
perm.employeeDeleteWhy: A soft delete — the record is hidden but past data stays.
perm.userManage: Create accounts, disable them, reset passwords
perm.roleManageWhy: Anyone with this can raise their own permissions. Give it only to real administrators.

roles.name: Role name
roles.nameHint: The name shows in the role column on the members screen, so pick something colleagues will understand.
roles.startsEmpty: A new role starts with no permissions. Turn them on in the table on the right after creating it.
roles.deleteText: The role is deleted for good. Anyone still holding it must be moved to another role first — the system refuses otherwise.
